title: Dritte Verordnung zur Änderung der Aufenthaltsverordnung vom 8. Mai 2008 (BGBl. 2008 I S. 806): preamble, Article 1 and Article 2, as transcribed on umwelt-online.de
in_force: the day after promulgation (Art. 2); promulgated 13 May 2008, so 14 May 2008; Anlage C was later replaced in full by Art. 12 of the Act of 22 November 2011
verified_how: Fetched https://umwelt-online.de/recht/allgemei/z08_0806.htm on 2026-11-02 (a demo page of a commercial site reproducing the gazette text); HTML converted to one line per paragraph, with the site's own header and footer lines removed. The gazette itself (bgbl.de archive, JavaScript viewer) was not read, so this is a transcription of a transcription. The point it is deposited for is one sentence of the preamble: the Interior Ministry acted 'auf Grund des § 99 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 des Aufenthaltsgesetzes'.
notes: German is the only authoritative language; any English in the encoding is a gloss. The regulation text is an amtliches Werk (UrhG § 5(1)); the site's presentation is not copied.
